rappel_detail.anchor: natural: rock horn or a sling around a block; no fixed hardware
rappel_detail.station: The short rock step just below the West-East McMillan saddle (the 4th-class rib, or the head of the steep snow gully).
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel on a single 30-40 m rope, instead of downclimbing loose or steep ground. Then reverse the snow and glacier traverse.

set.rappels: 1 rappel on a single 30-40 m rope over the rock step below the West-East McMillan saddle
